options.name: cluster
options.description: Name of the cluster to configure the resource pool. This parameter is required if O(esxi_hostname) or O(parent_resource_pool) is not specified. The O(cluster), O(esxi_hostname) and O(parent_resource_pool) parameters are mutually exclusive.

options.name: cpu_allocation_shares
options.description: The number of cpu shares allocated. This value is only set if O(cpu_shares=custom).

options.name: cpu_expandable_reservations
options.description: In a resource pool with an expandable reservation, the reservation on a resource pool can grow beyond the specified value.

options.name: cpu_limit
options.description: The utilization of a virtual machine/resource pool will not exceed this limit, even if there are available resources. The default value -1 indicates no limit.

options.name: cpu_reservation
options.description: Amount of resource that is guaranteed available to the virtual machine or resource pool.

options.name: cpu_shares
options.description: Memory shares are used in case of resource contention.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: Name of the datacenter.

options.name: esxi_hostname
options.description: Name of the host to configure the resource pool. The host must not be member of a cluster. This parameter is required if O(cluster) or O(parent_resource_pool) is not specified. The O(cluster), O(esxi_hostname) and O(parent_resource_pool) parameters are mutually exclusive.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: mem_allocation_shares
options.description: The number of memory shares allocated. This value is only set if O(mem_shares=custom).

options.name: mem_expandable_reservations
options.description: In a resource pool with an expandable reservation, the reservation on a resource pool can grow beyond the specified value.

options.name: mem_limit
options.description: The utilization of a virtual machine/resource pool will not exceed this limit, even if there are available resources. The default value -1 indicates no limit.

options.name: mem_reservation
options.description: Amount of resource that is guaranteed available to the virtual machine or resource pool.

options.name: mem_shares
options.description: Memory shares are used in case of resource contention.

options.name: parent_resource_pool
options.description: Name of the parent resource pool. This parameter is required if O(cluster) or O(esxi_hostname) is not specified. The O(cluster), O(esxi_hostname) and O(parent_resource_pool) parameters are mutually exclusive.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: The address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a hostname or a IP. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of the HTTP proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: resource_pool
options.description: Resource pool name to manage.

options.name: state
options.description: Add or remove the resource pool

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.
